attachments.origin_landmark: fascia over the lower nasal bone and upper lateral cartilage (bilateral; a single bone is named because the schema takes one origin)
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin of the glabella between the eyebrows

actions: draws the medial eyebrows downward, producing transverse wrinkles over the bridge of the nose

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: With corrugator supercilii it forms the glabellar complex -- the standard target for botulinum toxin treatment of frown lines, and the muscle group whose chemodenervation has been studied for depression.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
